renames.NLAlib/Polynomial/Chebyshev.lean: Polynomial/Chebyshev/Chebyshev.lean would repeat the leaf name; the file is Chebyshev growth outside [-1,1] (plus second-kind/derivative bounds), so Growth.
renames.NLAlib/Polynomial/Interpolation.lean: Polynomial/Interpolation/Interpolation.lean would repeat the leaf name; the file is the Lagrange interpolation remainder (Rolle, Cauchy remainder, Chebyshev nodes), so Lagrange.

notes: ForMathlib: 46 content files mapped (NLAlib/ForMathlib/Probability/FiniteLaw.lean has no declarations: it is an import-only aggregator, so it is left to the generated-aggregator step and not mapped); identity for 40 of them. The 6 files under Analysis/Calculus/, Analysis/InnerProductSpace/ and Analysis/Matrix/ are flattened into ForMathlib/Analysis/ because the checker only accepts the five ForMathlib leaves (base names kept except the two Matrix/ files, see renames). No ForMathlib file sits directly in NLAlib/ForMathlib/ today. No ForMathlib file imports a non-ForMathlib NLAlib module (layer -1 holds).
Polynomial: every file imports only Mathlib, Polynomial/ or ForMathlib/ (layer 0 holds).

Krylov: external NLAlib imports are only Matrix.{CourantFischer,Factorizations.Givens,PolynomialCalculus,PolynomialIntertwining,PowerRayleigh,PrincipalAngles,Projections} and Polynomial.{Basic,Approximation,AnalyticApproximation,Exponential,Jackson}; the layer check therefore depends only on M1 keeping those Matrix files at layer 0. Krylov is imported from LowRank/ and Estimation/ only.

Polynomial sharp-Jackson subtree (Jackson, JacksonPeriodic, JacksonPolynomial, Sawtooth{Interpolation,Derivative,Zeros,Sign,SquareWave,Norm}, SquareWave, SineBasis) moved wholesale to BestApproximation; CosineBasis (generic T-basis expansion, no Jackson import) goes to Chebyshev.

Polynomial analytic subtree (BernsteinEllipse, AnalyticCoefficients, AnalyticFourier, AnalyticApproximation) moved wholesale to FunctionApproximation; AnalyticInterpolation (Lagrange interpolant at the Chebyshev extrema grid) goes to Interpolation.

Krylov Solvers holds the generic minimiser layer (Minimiser: IsAffineMinimiser, residual polynomials, class theorem) and CGRecurrence next to CG: CGRecurrence imports CG, so in Processes it would make Processes depend on Solvers; Processes is kept for the basis-building processes (Arnoldi, Lanczos, Golub-Kahan).

Krylov CharacteristicPolynomial (the compression's charpoly is the unique monic minimiser of ||p(A)b||, i.e. the Arnoldi/Ritz minimisation property) goes to Spectral; MeasurableRitz (measurable Lanczos Ritz value) goes to Spectral.

Polynomial Minimax (Chebyshev extremal/minimax/monic-minimality) goes to BestApproximation rather than Chebyshev; LanczosFilterMean goes to Chebyshev beside EvenChebyshevFilter, its only NLAlib import.
Coordinator: ForMathlib nested paths kept (checker now allows ForMathlib/<Area>/**); FiniteLaw shim mapped to itself.
flags: NLAlib/Krylov/Bidiagonalization.lean: placed in Krylov/Processes, not Spectral as KRYLOV_DEFINITIONS §6/the brief suggest. Its content is the GolubKahanDecomp predicate (graded bases of (AA^T, b) and (A^T A, A^T b)), the Golub-Kahan relation and the Golub-Kahan recurrence, the exact analogue of Arnoldi/LanczosRecurrence; it contains no singular-value or Ritz statement. Flip to Spectral with a one-line change if preferred.

NLAlib/Krylov/AnalyticQuadrature.lean: mixed (one Gauss-quadrature bound, one krylovFunApprox bound for analytic f); placed in Quadrature; split the krylovFunApprox corollary into MatrixFunctions later.

NLAlib/Krylov/ExponentialQuadrature.lean: mixed (two quadrature bounds for x^s and exp(-x), one krylovFunApprox bound for exp); placed in Quadrature (dominant); split the krylovFunApprox corollary into MatrixFunctions later.

NLAlib/Krylov/Block.lean: mixed (blockKrylovSpace, dominant, plus the subspaceIterate definition and its basis-independence lemmas used by SubspaceIteration/PowerMethod/QRAlgorithm); placed in Spaces; subspaceIterate could later move to Spectral (e.g. Spectral/SubspaceIteration).

NLAlib/Krylov/FunctionApprox.lean: contains matrix-calculus helpers (cfc_eq_aeval_of_forall_eval_eq, cfc_eq_aeval_interpolate, dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_self_le) whose own docstring says they belong in Matrix/PolynomialCalculus (Matrix/Functions); split later.

NLAlib/Krylov/Arnoldi.lean: imports NLAlib.Krylov.GaussQuadrature (Processes -> Quadrature) but uses no declaration of GaussQuadrature or SpectralMeasure by name; likely only needs Matrix.Projections/Krylov.Grade transitively. Legal within Krylov, but the Processes -> Quadrature edge is backwards and should be dropped when someone next edits the file.

NLAlib/Polynomial/Approximation.lean: mixed (chebyshevAmplifier bounds and the condition-number form of the Chebyshev minimax bound, which are Chebyshev/BestApproximation material, plus the 1/x approximation); placed in FunctionApproximation because 1/x is its consumer-facing result and Ritz/CG/GMRES/LowRank cite it as one module; split later.

NLAlib/Polynomial/SineBasis.lean: mixed (generic Chebyshev-U basis spanning and sine expansions, plus exists_sine_expansion_sawtoothApprox, which needs SawtoothInterpolation); placed with the Jackson subtree in BestApproximation; the generic part could move to Chebyshev later.

Proposal: Polynomial/BestApproximation now holds 12 files, 11 of them the sharp-Jackson proof (sawtooth interpolation, square wave, periodic and algebraic Jackson). A Polynomial/Jackson (or Polynomial/Trigonometric) leaf is clearly warranted; not used here because it is not in the tree.

ForMathlib nesting: the 6 files under ForMathlib/Analysis/{Calculus,InnerProductSpace,Matrix}/ mirror Mathlib paths (Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.IteratedDeriv, Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.GramSchmidtOrtho, Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.Order); flattening them loses the upstream-path correspondence that ForMathlib exists for. Better: let the checker accept any path under ForMathlib/<Area>/** and map these 6 to themselves.

NLAlib/ForMathlib/Probability/FiniteLaw.lean: not mapped. It has no declarations (a compatibility shim that only imports FiniteLawIndependent), so the checker counts it as an aggregator, but it sits inside a leaf and is not a generated <Dir>.lean aggregator. --apply must either keep it in place or delete it and point its importers at FiniteLawIndependent; check that it is not silently dropped.
